Synopsis:
This dialogue triggers when players enter a village being guarded by goblins. The goblins are on rooftops - the player may either be on the ground or on the rooftops with them (if they've snuck in). If the player has passed a perception check beforehand, the dialogue starts while the goblins are still getting into place for an ambush. Otherwise, the goblins are already in place, surrounding the player.If the player is not a drow, the goblins will attack the player at the end of the dialogue unless players can talk them out of it.

Cluster Contexts:
- FOR_GoblinAmbush.json: The player has entered a small village watched by goblins positioned on rooftops; depending on a prior perception check the goblins are either still moving into ambush positions or already surrounding the player. Booyahg is the snarky goblin leader on duty, annoyed at guard duty and eager to threaten or skewer trespassers but also pragmatic if the player seems dangerous. A strange glowing symbol appears on the goblins and provokes a reaction in the player, suggesting some supernatural resonance during the encounter. If the player is not a drow the default outcome is violence unless the player can talk the goblins down; some dialogue lines and responses vary based on unseen checks (sneak/perception/intimidation/persuasion).
- NGB_FOR_Village_Trespassing.json: This guard has come upon you sneaking through a village her force is occupying. She was bored and sees you as a potential source of fun (ie, someone to murder/bully).  Defaulting to she, but numerous goblins could deliver this dialogue as it's a dynamic crime one.
- LOW_NGB_SharGrotto_Trespassing.json: Trespass NGB dialogue with a Shar Grotto guard. Narrator lines indicate how the player has been caught where they shouldn't be.
- LOW_Elfsong_Githyanki_InquisitorInterrogation.json: Dialog when the Githyanki in the Knights of the Shield hideout spots the player.
- FOR_GnomeGoblin6.json: A goblin tracker stands guard as their leader torments a captive. If the player interferes, they turn hostile (unless the player is a drow - in this case the goblins are servile and afraid).

context: You step into a small village occupied and watched from the rooftops by goblin guards; depending on a prior Perception check the goblins are either still moving into ambush positions or already surrounding you, and you may be standing on the ground or up among the roofs with them. Booyahg is the snarky goblin leader on duty — annoyed at guard work, quick to threaten or skewer trespassers, but pragmatic and willing to back off if a foe seems genuinely dangerous. A strange glowing symbol appears on the goblins and causes a supernatural stir in the player, which factors into reactions. Unless you are a drow (in which case the goblins are deferential/afraid), the default outcome is violence unless you can talk or intimidate them into standing down; several lines and outcomes are determined by unseen checks (sneak/perception/intimidation/persuasion). The sample excerpts only show a few possible reactions (threatening, goading, or grudging retreat).
